desc.Charge: Charge an enemy, generate 12 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.
desc.Hamstring: Maims the enemy, causing 18 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 45% for 15 sec.
desc.Heroic Strike: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 58 and causes a high amount of threat.
desc.Mocking Blow: A mocking attack that causes 46 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.
desc.Overpower: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 15. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.
desc.Rend: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 66 damage over 18 sec.
desc.Retaliation: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.
desc.Thunder Clap: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 22 sec and doing 55 damage to them.  Will affect up to 4 targets.
desc.Victory Rush: Instantly attack the target causing (1 + Attack Power * 45 / 100) damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.  Only useable within 20 sec after you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor.
desc.Tactical Mastery: You retain up to 5 of your rage points when you change stances.
desc.Battle Shout: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 20 yards by 94.  Lasts 2 min.
desc.Berserker Rage: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage.  Lasts 10 sec.
desc.Berserker Stance: An aggressive stance.  Critical hit chance is increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.
desc.Challenging Shout: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.
desc.Cleave: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 10 to the target and his nearest ally.
desc.Demoralizing Shout: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 80 for 30 sec.
desc.Execute: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 200 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 6 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.
desc.Intimidating Shout: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear.  Up to 5 total nearby enemies will flee in fear.  Lasts 8 sec.
desc.Pummel: Pummel the target for 20 damage.  It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.
desc.Slam: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 43.
desc.Whirlwind: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage to each enemy.
desc.Bloodrage: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.  The warrior is considered in combat for the duration.
desc.Defensive Stance: A defensive combat stance.  Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%.  Increases threat generated.
desc.Disarm: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.
desc.Revenge: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 25 to 31 damage and a high amount of threat.   Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.
desc.Shield Bash: Bashes the target with your shield for 18 damage.  It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.
desc.Shield Block: Increases chance to block by 75% for 5 sec, but will only block 1 attack.
desc.Shield Wall: Reduces the damage taken from melee attacks, ranged attacks and spells by 75% for 10 sec.
desc.Sunder Armor: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 270 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat.  Can be applied up to 5 times.  Lasts 30 sec.
desc.Taunt: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

desc.Blessing of Wisdom: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 24 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Consecration: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 24 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 56 damage over 8 sec.
desc.Exorcism: Causes 194 to 218 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.
desc.Flash of Light: Heals a friendly target for 101 to 114.
desc.Holy Light: Heals a friendly target for 717 to 799.
desc.Lay on Hands: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 250 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining mana but does not interrupt mana regeneration.
desc.Purify: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.
desc.Redemption: Brings a dead player back to life with 250 health and 420 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.
desc.Seal of Light: Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 39. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 25. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
desc.Seal of Righteousness: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 10 to 37 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 90 to 99 Holy damage to an enemy.
desc.Seal of Wisdom: Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 50 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 33 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
desc.Sense Undead: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled.   Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.
desc.Turn Undead: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 15 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only one target can be turned at a time.
desc.Blessing of Freedom: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Blessing of Kings: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Blessing of Protection: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 10 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
desc.Blessing of Salvation: Places a Blessing on the party member, reducing the amount of all threat generated by 30% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Concentration Aura: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Devotion Aura: Gives 390 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Divine Intervention: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way.  Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.
desc.Divine Protection: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
desc.Divine Shield: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
desc.Fire Resistance Aura: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Frost Resistance Aura: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Righteous Fury: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 90%. Lasts 30 min.
desc.Seal of Fury: Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 19 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy causes 81 to 90 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec.
desc.Seal of Justice: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing.  Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
desc.Shadow Resistance Aura: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party members within 30 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Blessing of Might: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 61 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Holy Strike: An instant strike that causes 42.0% weapon damage plus an additional 17 to 21 as Holy damage.
desc.Judgement: Unleashes the energy of a Seal on the target. Judgement no longer consumes the seal. Judging Seal of Fury taunts the target for 4 sec.
desc.Retribution Aura: Causes 18 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
desc.Seal of Command: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 76% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 192 to 212 Holy damage, 385 to 424 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.
desc.Seal of the Crusader: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 157 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 92. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

desc.Armor Proficiency: You are proficient in the use of the armor types your class can wear (the demo Druid listed Cloth and Leather).
desc.Dodge: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.
desc.Entangling Roots: Roots the target in place and causes 20 Nature damage over 12 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only useable outdoors.
desc.Faerie Fire: Decrease the armor of the target by 285 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.
desc.Hibernate: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 30 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.
desc.Moonfire: Burns the enemy for 61 to 72 Arcane damage and then an additional 96 Arcane damage over 12 sec.
desc.Nature's Grasp: While active, any time an enemy strikes the caster they have a 35% chance to become afflicted by Entangling Roots (Rank 4).  Only useable outdoors.  1 charge.  Lasts 45 sec.
desc.Omen of Clarity: Your spells and attacks have a chance to grant you Clearcasting, reducing the Mana, Rage, or Energy cost of your next damage or healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. Clearcasting is not consumed by Wrath or by spells or abilities that cost no resources.
desc.Soothe Animal: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards.  Only affects Beast targets level 55 or lower.  Lasts 15 sec.
desc.Starfire: Causes 145 to 172 Arcane damage to the target.
desc.Thorns: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 12 Nature damage to attackers when hit.  Lasts 10 min.
desc.Aquatic Form: Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
desc.Bear Form: Shapeshift into a bear, increasing melee attack power by 114, armor contribution from items by 180%, and health by 180. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
desc.Cat Form: Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 76 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
desc.Challenging Roar: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.
desc.Claw: Claw the enemy for 110% normal damage plus 62. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Cower: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.
desc.Dash: Increases movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.
desc.Demoralizing Roar: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 101. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.Enrage: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.
desc.Ferocious Bite: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 1 additional damage.  Damage is increased by your Attack Power.   1 point  : 50-66 damage   2 points: 86-102 damage   3 points: 122-138 damage   4 points: 158-174 damage   5 points: 194-210 damage
desc.Frenzied Regeneration: Converts up to 10 rage per second into health for 10 sec.  Each point of rage is converted into 10 health.
desc.Growl: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.
desc.Maul: Increases the druid's next attack by 49 damage.
desc.Pounce: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 90 damage over 18 sec.  Must be prowling and behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Prowl: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled.
desc.Rake: Rake the target for 28 damage and an additional 57 damage over 9 sec.  Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Ravage: Ravage the target, causing 350% damage plus 147 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Rip: Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:   1 point  : [6 * 1 * (15)] damage over 12 sec.   2 points: [6 * 1 * (24)] damage over 12 sec.   3 points: [6 * 1 * (33)] damage over 12 sec.   4 points: [6 * 1 * (42)] damage over 12 sec.   5 points: [6 * 1 * (51)] damage over 12 sec.
desc.Shred: Shred the target, causing 155% damage plus 99 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.
desc.Tiger's Fury: Increases Physical damage done by 15% for 6 sec, and instantly grants 60 Energy.
desc.Track Humanoids: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.  Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.
desc.Travel Form: Transforms the druid into a travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
desc.Abolish Poison: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.
desc.Healing Touch: Heals a friendly target for 858 to 1,023.
desc.Mark of the Wild: Increases the friendly target's armor by 203, all attributes by 8 and all resistances by 7 for 1 hour.
desc.Rebirth: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 750 health and 1200 mana.
desc.Regrowth: Heals a friendly target for 385 to 434 and another 375 over 21 sec.
desc.Rejuvenation: Heals the target for 313 over 15 sec.
desc.Remove Curse: Dispels 1 Curse from a friendly target.
desc.Revive: Brings a dead player back to life with 15% of their health and mana.  Cannot be used when in combat.
desc.Tranquility: Regenerates all nearby group members for 98 every 2 seconds for 10 sec.  Druid must channel to maintain the spell.
